codelines.name: mocka
codelines.reason: MOCK3-1 covers the senior-fare boundary bug, and this repository's src/fares.ts contains the fare rule where riders aged 65 and over should pay the concession fare but age > 65 excludes exactly 65.
codelines.evidence: ticket component "mocka"; src/fares.ts: "if (rider.age > 65) return CONCESSION_FARE_CENTS;" under the comment "Riders aged 65 AND OVER pay the concession fare."

facts.text: Tests are run with vitest via the package.json script "test": "vitest run"; the build check is "build": "tsc --noEmit" and lint is a no-op ("lint": "echo no-lint-configured").

Source lives in src/fares.ts and its tests in test/fares.test.ts; the existing suite has no case for a rider aged exactly 65, only age 70 ("charges the concession fare well past the senior boundary"), so the boundary bug is untested.

codelines.name: mockb
codelines.reason: MOCK3-2 covers the departure board omitting the final stop, and this repository's src/schedule.ts contains formatStops looping to stops.length - 1, dropping the last stop, while totalMinutes is computed independently and stays correct.
codelines.evidence: ticket component "mockb"; src/schedule.ts: "for (let i = 0; i < stops.length - 1; i++)" in formatStops

facts.text: Tests are run with vitest via the package.json script "test": "vitest run"; the build check is "build": "tsc --noEmit" and lint is a no-op ("lint": "echo no-lint-configured").

Source lives in src/schedule.ts and its tests in test/schedule.test.ts; the existing formatStops tests only assert the arrow separator and the first stop's name, never that the last stop appears, which is why the omission passes the suite.
